Screen reference sequences for contaminants and NUMTs

Source: R/qc.R
rb_qc_screening.Rd

Functions to identify sequences that match known contaminants or nuclear mitochondrial pseudogenes (NUMTs).

  • rb_screen_contaminants(): Screens sequences against a BLAST database.

  • rb_screen_numts(): Screens sequences against a FASTA file of known NUMTs using exact substring matching.

Usage

rb_screen_contaminants(
  sequences,
  blast_db,
  perc_identity = 95,
  evalue = 1e-20,
  min_pident = 95,
  min_length = 100,
  threads = 1,
  blastn = "blastn"
)

rb_screen_numts(sequences, numt_fasta, min_match_length = 50)

Arguments

sequences

Character vector of DNA sequences to screen.

blast_db

Path prefix to a BLAST nucleotide database.

perc_identity

Minimum percent identity passed directly to BLAST -perc_identify flag as a hard pre-filter for BLAST hits.

evalue

E-value threshold for BLAST hits.

min_pident

Post-filter minimum percent identity threshold applied to the BLAST results to flag as contaminant.

min_length

Minimum alignment length to flag as contaminant.

threads

Number of BLAST threads.

blastn

Path to the blastn executable.

numt_fasta

Path to a FASTA file of known NUMT sequences.

min_match_length

Sequences shorter than this are not screened.

Value

A logical vector where TRUE indicates the sequence was flagged.

See also

Other quality control: rb_qc_checks, rb_qc_pipeline
